presentation.limits attributes on an unfinished tag: L1 boundary (P1's list). The body ends inside a tag that has reached Gumbo's attribute limit; Gumbo refuses it and Rails renders nothing, AngleSharp drops the unfinished tag and renders the rest. Class B, hostile-only.
presentation.og mailto raises: R8 (System.Uri behind the RFC 3986 character check). Ruby raises URI::InvalidComponentError on `mailto:nobody` (an opaque part it cannot read), which blanks the message; System.Uri reads a mailto URL and the embed renders without a link. Class B, hand-made bodies only.
presentation.og dots host raises: R8 (System.Uri behind the RFC 3986 character check). Ruby accepts a host with empty labels (`example..com`) and raises NoMethodError on `...` (a host with no label), which blanks the message; System.Uri refuses the first (no link) and the second (no link, no raise). Class B, hand-made bodies only.
